title: General Election to Parliamentary Constituencies: Trends & Results June-2024
relevantTableOrPage: Candidate-wise Results Table (24 Candidates + NOTA) — PC 2 - SRINAGAR (UT: U08)
fieldsUnavailable: Booth-level socio-economic voter demographics (Not published in statutory summary)
Real-time hourly polling logs (Provisional data superseded by Form 20 declaration)
assumptionsAndLimitations: Conducted under newly delimited 18 Assembly segments spanning 5 districts. Official ECI counting results record 6,75,242 total votes counted across all 24 candidates and NOTA. All candidate vote shares are computed using this certified denominator of 6,75,242 (yielding Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi 52.85%, Waheed Ur Rehman Para 24.95%, winning margin percentage 27.90%). Certified final voter turnout is 38.63% (6,75,242 / 1,747,810). Earlier widely-cited press reports of 38.49% turnout were based on the CEO's provisional EVM estimate of ~6,72,836 votes released on poll evening (13 May 2024) prior to postal ballot counting.
